ratings.comment: This woman talks to you like you're in kindergarten. Her tests are hard for a sole fact that she tries to trick you on the wording. Avoid her if possible.

She was rude, nonprofessional and honestly came off as unintelligent.  She spoke to us like we were idiots and well below her. I would not recommend her for anyone, even if you're interested in her content. She was not a good professor.

She was clear in many of the lectures, goes through slides quite quick and gets angry if asked to go back, although the slides are online. Has lots of clicker questions but they are very helpful as in they do prepare you for what the exam will be like. She taught the Evolution portion of the class.

Kelly was a horrible professor. Very condescending and rude. Doesn't care about helping students. Also goes through powerpoints too quickly and won't go back. You basically teach yourself. Avoid Kelly if you can.

So incredibly rude. I have never met a professor who was as UNprofessional as her. Absolutely no assistance, and when asking her for help, she responds very condescending. The class itself was not too bad if you put in the effort. However, don't expect anything on her end- go to lectures and read the book if you need clarity.
Patronizing tone of voice, slide changes way too fast and will not go back even if you ask nicely. Avoid getting her at all costs.
